cohort_rules.testish_rule: is_reviewer OR an identifier contains test, demo, playwright, codex, claude, fable, dev_user, example.com, or localhost; identifiers are used in production only and are not exported
cohort_rules.mature_pwc_session: created at least 24 hours before the measurement and not explicitly terminated as e2e_trace_test, e2e_test, or drive_verify

narrow_auth_return.definition: a user_sessions.created_at timestamp on a later UTC calendar date than users.created_at
narrow_auth_return.limitation: session tokens are long lived; absence of a new user_sessions row does not prove absence of a later product visit

last_login_recent_activity.definition: distinct users.last_login within the preceding 30 days
last_login_recent_activity.limitation: last_login is populated for only 38 of 125 users and is not a complete activity authority

recent_direct_action_comparison.limitation: some lesson/session creation may come from validation or administrative operation; current records do not carry a uniform environment or actor provenance field

pwc_early_exit.definition: mature non-admin sessions with fewer than two move_history entries whose by field equals player

reported_2_6_percent_reproduction.definition: all mature accounts, decided result, at least ten player moves

non_admin_comparison.definition: non-admin mature sessions, decided result, at least three player moves

non_admin_non_testish_comparison.definition: non-admin/non-testish mature sessions, decided result, at least ten player moves
non_admin_non_testish_comparison.limitation: small cohort; the exclusion heuristic must not become a permanent metric without explicit provenance

comparison_to_independent_report.reported_105_of_119_day_zero: directionally reproduced by the narrow auth-session definition, but the exact historical denominator cannot be reconstructed from the current 125-user state without the original query and cutoff
comparison_to_independent_report.reported_45_percent_before_move_two: reproduced as 45.58 percent for mature non-admin sessions with fewer than two player moves
comparison_to_independent_report.reported_2_6_percent_wins: reproduced as 2.59 percent only for all mature accounts with at least ten player moves; not acceptable as a clean customer metric
comparison_to_independent_report.reported_six_recent_users: reproduced exactly using users.last_login, but that field is too incomplete to serve as the retention authority

decision.reason: last_login, auth-session creation, and direct-action records produce materially different reach counts and lack uniform internal/test provenance
decision.next_measurement_requirement: use one canonical, server-observed user-action contract with actor/environment provenance for a fresh cohort before locking the improvement target
